branch_counterexample.scope: Read-only diagnosis after user challenged the branch explanation. Same fixed deal and public history, using the preserved candidate library for both descriptors. Exhaustive enumeration from pares to terminal, independent of policy learning and RNG. This is not an MCCFR benchmark or a full root tree count.
branch_counterexample.history: no mus; grande +10 accepted; chica +10 accepted
branch_counterexample.explanation: The legacy numeric budget adds the hidden settled maximum to the accepted prior, so the same accepted stakes are counted in both terms in rival0. Public budget uses paid points and accepted pending stakes once. The keys merge across hidden rival hands at the opening of pares, while the action menu expands. The public key also stores both players paid points instead of only a maximum, introducing additional distinctions between public histories. External-sampling MCCFR shares strategy data by infoset but does not collapse all concrete game histories into one traversal.
branch_counterexample.limitation: This proves a concrete source of branch expansion. It does not apportion the aggregate runtime or store-size increase across action menus, changed public key distinctions, and changed sampled training histories.
